ranked.explanation: Meio da Baia looks like a fun-sized window for Worth checking, Medium confidence: 0.6-0.9 m, 102 kJ, 9 s period, consistent 70/100, and wind is not fully clear.  An inconsistent Baía spot that can work well when north-northwest swell reaches the bay; this is best for bodyboard sessions when the bay is clean, there is enough period and size, and the forecast shows a defined wave; 6-9s at low tide can still make exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia punchy.  Expect: it is less reliable than the main bay spots, so weak swell or short period can make it feel soft.
